comment: Turns the Check / Money Order offline payment method on or off.
modal: Controls whether **Check / Money Order** is offered as a payment option at checkout. Set to **Yes** to make it available, **No** to hide it. Can be set per website.

comment: The status assigned to new orders paid by Check / Money Order.
modal: The order status applied when an order is placed with **Check / Money Order**, chosen from the statuses mapped to the New order state. Can be set per website.

comment: The position of Check / Money Order in the list of payment methods at checkout.
modal: A numeric sort value that sets where **Check / Money Order** appears relative to other payment methods; lower numbers show first.

comment: The name shown for the Check / Money Order method at checkout.
modal: The label customers see for this payment method during checkout. Can differ per website or store view, so each store can word it in its own language.

comment: Whether Check / Money Order is offered in all countries or only selected ones.
modal: Chooses between **All Allowed Countries** and **Specific Countries** for where this method is available. When set to specific countries, the list is chosen in *Payment from Specific Countries*.

comment: The countries that can use Check / Money Order when payment is limited to specific countries.
modal: The billing countries allowed to use this method. Applies only when **Payment from Applicable Countries** is set to Specific Countries.

comment: The payee name customers should make the check out to.
modal: The name shown to the customer as the party the check or money order should be made payable to. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The address customers should mail their check or money order to.
modal: The postal address displayed to the customer for sending the check or money order. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The smallest order total for which Check / Money Order is offered.
modal: The minimum order total required for this method to appear at checkout. Orders below this amount cannot use it.

comment: The largest order total for which Check / Money Order is offered.
modal: The maximum order total for which this method appears at checkout. Orders above this amount cannot use it.
